narrator-padre.description: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with a neutral São Paulo accent, never European Portuguese. Male, 60 to 70. Studio quality. Persona: old parish priest reading the Gospel at Mass. Emotion: serene, fatherly, reverent. A warm, slightly aged voice, slow and clear.

narrator-jovem.description: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with a neutral São Paulo accent, never European Portuguese. Male, 28 to 35. Studio quality. Persona: young lector. Emotion: clear, sincere, attentive. A bright, natural voice reading Scripture simply, without theatricality.

narrator-grave.description: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with a neutral São Paulo accent, never European Portuguese. Male, 40 to 50. Studio quality. Persona: audiobook narrator. Emotion: deep, composed, intimate. A rich baritone, close to the microphone, unhurried.

narrator-mulher.description: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with a neutral São Paulo accent, never European Portuguese. Female, 40 to 50. Studio quality. Persona: woman reading Scripture aloud. Emotion: calm, warm, reverent. A low, clear voice, measured and unhurried.
